title: Between Jumps: The Work Behind a 2-Hour Airborne Mission
summary: In less than two hours of flight time, an Alaska Air National Guard crew supported active-duty Army and Air National Guard parachutists at three altitudes, deployed free-fall parabundles and practiced visual and instrument landing system approaches.
author: Dana Rosso, Alaska National Guard
title_norm: between jumps the work behind a 2 hour airborne mission
